posted: The Circle is Now Complete
notes: No starting section is posted. The strategy says 'You always start Start Your Engines for the Pod Stuff and Watto's Box', so Start Your Engines! is the starting interrupt and Watto's Box (an Effect that deploys for free) the starting effect; Hunt Down is the objective. All are in the list and count toward the 60 (section counts 6+11+2+3+11+27 = 60).
Posted '3x Numbers' dested 3,720 To 1: the strategy's '3,720 to 1' section ('drop an Odds') describes it as one of the deck's damage engines and no other card in the list is Odds.

Posted 'Something Special' dested Something Special Planned For Them; 'Visage' dested Visage Of The Emperor; 'Twi'lek' dested Twi'lek Advisor; 'Tech M'Or' dested Tech Mo'r; 'Darth Vader, DLOTS' dested Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'Ommni Box & It's Worse' kept as the combo interrupt.
Podrace Arena and Boonta Eve Podrace dested the Dark Tatooine pages; Weapon Levitation the Dark Cloud City interrupt; Secret Plans and No Escape are Effects in 2001.
The description says the deck won 'the last tournament here in St. Louis'; no event is named, so it stays a general DeckTech list.
